data.name: Hyperflora
data.detailed_description:
Combat botany at the edge of the cosmos.

Hack, slash, and harvest across uncharted alien worlds. Collect rare cosmic plants brimming with unnatural power to cultivate in your orbital greenhouse. Refine their essence, craft otherworldly weapons and armor, and venture beyond.

HUNT

Fight through dungeon depths for rare alien specimens.

CULTIVATE

Grow them in your orbital greenhouse. What thrives yields essence.

REFINE

Forge essence into otherworldly weapons and armor.

ASCEND

Grow stronger. Forage deeper. Go again.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit (version 21H1) or newer
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 8500, or Ryzen 3 3100
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA Geforce GTX 1050, or similar
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: An Internet connection is required to save progress. Gamepad recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-10400 / AMD Ryzen 5 3600 or better
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DirectX 12 capable GPU with 4 GB VRAM (NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 / AMD Radeon RX 580)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: An Internet connection is required to save progress. Gamepad recommended.

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: macOS 12.0 Monterey or later
  • Processor: Apple M1 or Intel Core i5 equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 2 compatible GPU; Apple M1 or Intel Iris Plus / AMD Radeon Pro (2GB VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Universal binary — runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel. An Internet connection is required to save progress. Gamepad recommended.
mac_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: macOS Sequoia or later
  • Processor: Apple M2 or newer, or Intel Core i7
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal 3 compatible GPU; Apple M2 or AMD Radeon Pro 5500 XT / 6000 series (4GB+ VRAM)
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Universal binary — runs natively on Apple Silicon and Intel. An Internet connection is required to save progress. Gamepad recommended.
